# Revolutionaries
[color=#999999][italic]"Long live the revolution!!"[/italic][/color]
Revolutionaries are conversion antagonists sponsored by the [color=#ff0000]Syndicate[/color] whose mission is to seize control of the station. They have no clever tricks, only a cause and strength in numbers.
## Objectives You must recruit, shackle, or kill every member of [bold]Command[/bold], in any order.
Your goal is [bold]not to destroy the station[/bold], but to [italic]seize it[/italic], so try to keep damage to a minimum.
[bold]The revolution will lose[/bold] if every [bold][color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionary[/color][/bold] dies—all [color=red]Revolutionaries[/color] will be deconverted immediately.
## Caches The [color=#ff0000]Syndicate's[/color] pawns have kindly hidden between 6 and 15 caches. Anyone can find them, but [bold][color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionaries[/color][/bold] have a pinpointer that tracks their locations. To find them, you will need a T-ray scanner, as well as a crowbar and wrench to lift the floor tiles.
## Head Revolutionaries and conversion [bold][color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionaries[/color][/bold] are selected at the start of the shift and begin with a [color=cyan]flash[/color] and [color=cyan]sunglasses[/color].
You can convert a crewmember to your cause by attacking them with any [bold]flash[/bold] while in [color=#ff0000]combat mode[/color]. However, [bold]you cannot convert a target wearing [color=cyan]flash protection[/color][/bold], such as glasses or a welding mask.
Another obstacle is [color=cyan]mindshield implants[/color]. They: - Prevent the implanted person from becoming a [color=red]Revolutionary[/color] - Deconvert Revolutionaries, removing their loyalty to the [color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionary[/color] - [bold]Are visibly destroyed when implanted into a [color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionary[/color][/bold], giving you away - Do NOT protect against disorientation from a flash
Assume that [color=#cb0000]Security[/color] personnel already have implants. Some Command roles may also be protected, and even without a mindshield you cannot recruit a Head of Department unless they are an acting head promoted from the rank and file. [bold]A mindshield implant can be removed with an implant extractor after selecting mindshield extraction.[/bold]
You can obtain an extractor in several ways: - The [color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionary[/color] starts with its autolathe design - An extractor may be found in a cache - You can wait for Research to study implants and print one at a MedFab
[bold]Build-specific detail:[/bold] station heads cannot be converted even if they do not have a mindshield. The revolution's targets are only round-start Heads or Heads arriving from the Spaceport; acting Heads do not count as full Heads and are not revolution objectives.
### BlueShield Officer - This special role is responsible for protecting Command members. All Heads carry [bold]BlueShield alert implants[/bold]. These implants [color=red][bold]automatically[/bold][/color] notify the BlueShield over the radio when a Head enters critical condition. - Tip: sabotage the telecommunications servers, find a way to disable radios and clothing tracking sensors, or strike suddenly so your opponents have no time to regroup.
## Revolutionary A [color=red]Revolutionary[/color] is a crewmember converted by a [bold][color=#5e9cff]Head Revolutionary[/color][/bold].
[bold][color=red]Revolutionaries[/color] cannot convert others,[/bold] but they can do the dirty work and follow orders.
